data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 家庭餐厅
data.description: 傍晚家庭餐厅的卡座里，雪乃换上青灰色开衫、白棉上衣和深灰百褶中裙，双手的刀叉暂时停在切开的汉堡肉上方，抬眼听对面的人说话。近处餐盘、水杯与折好的餐巾各有位置，卡座背后的矮隔板接向过道与更远的靠窗餐桌，窗外街灯映在玻璃上。吊灯从左上照亮她的侧脸、餐具和酱汁，盘沿、水杯在桌面留下分开的柔影，靠背下部保持较暗——「偶尔来这种充满平民烟火气的地方倒也别有风味。今天就破例听你聊聊那些无聊的话题吧。」
data.location: 家庭餐厅靠窗卡座，低隔板后为过道与相邻餐桌
data.action: 双手刀叉停在切开的汉堡肉上方，抬眼望向画面外坐在对面的人。
data.lighting: warm pendant from the upper left on face, utensils and sauce; subdued evening window reflections
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, meal, hands and restaurant aisle visible
data.promptProse: Paused above the cut edge of her hamburger steak, Yukino's knife and fork remain in their separate hands as she looks toward the unseen diner opposite. Her blue-grey cardigan and white blouse sit neatly above a charcoal pleated skirt, with red hair ribbons visible at her side locks. A water glass and folded napkin occupy the near table corner beside the plate. The booth back meets a low partition; a clear aisle continues behind it toward a row of window tables. Evening streetlamp reflections lie faintly on the glass. Keep the meal and both hands inside an eye-level medium portrait. A pendant from the upper left warms her cheek and gives the utensils and sauce small highlights. Plate and glass cast distinct soft shadows, with the lower seat back remaining darker than the tabletop.
